description: How each step of an automation is doing: per current step, its step_id, position, sent, delivered, opened and clicked. Opens and clicks are unique people, counted only after link scanners are ruled out, so they are lower than raw hit counts and reflect readers. Use it to see where a sequence loses people or which step to rewrite; list_automations has only enrolment counts. A step's figures follow it when an edit moves it. An unknown automation_id answers 404 not_found.

automation_id.description: The automation's id from list_automations (a UUID), not its name or slug

name: get_automation_metrics
